entries.scope: Ban CAA, also sold as Command Arms Accessories. Match the standalone word CAA and the phrase Command Arms, including hyphenated slugs such as command-arms. Do not match CAA as a substring inside another word.
Ban Uncle Mike's. Match Uncle Mike's, Uncle Mikes, and slug forms such as uncle-mikes. Matching is case-insensitive.
Ban BlackHawk SERPA holsters, SERPA QD, and other SERPA attachments. A match requires the word SERPA. BlackHawk products that do not include SERPA stay allowed.
